about: The body each sex stands on (D111, D599), read by the game (crates/terra_walker/src/appearance.rs): its model; the file its clips come from, on its skeleton (the model's own if none); and the folder of the worn looks made on it (none: what is worn on it is not drawn). A wardrobe body's folder holds what no piece of his is the look of (the packs, the quiver), fitted over his default look by the build's wardrobe-gear step. A wardrobe body (D611) names its row of the wardrobe catalogue, wardrobe.json, which gives its model (his skeleton, sockets and clips) and the pieces the game composes him from, a piece a slot. The man is Quaternius's, in the wardrobe; the woman stands on the old base until her own body comes in (docs/v0-characters.md).
